goal: Play a full round and use the new feature: Visual and feel pass (art, juice, readability; no gameplay rules change): In ShopUi.client.luau, scale-tween the panel in on open with a whoosh (GameAssets.play) and increment a shop_opened counter. On a successful buy, play the buy sound, flash the row green, tween a level bar fill, and increment shop_purchases. Buying must use the same server validation as the pads. If the player has too little cash, shake the row and play an error buzz. Use the existing GameAssets and UiTheme.. It has on-screen UI: use it like a player, through its buttons (`ui` + press): open its panel and press its action buttons (claim, buy, equip), and check what changed
summary: The playtester opened the shop through the SHOP button and bought Dropper 2, Speed 1, Silver Ore and Dropper 3 through the on-screen Buy buttons. The probe confirms the feature: shop_opened=2, shop_purchases=4 and purchase_fx_sent=4. The Buy buttons on the lower cards (Cash x1.5 and Gold Ore) never fired, so the too-little-cash shake and buzz path could not be exercised, and those two items could not be bought even when affordable.

bugs.title: Lower shop cards (Cash x1.5, Gold Ore) Buy buttons do not fire
bugs.evidence: Steps 5, 8, 9 and 10: presses on Card_mult1.State (y=640) and Card_tier_gold.State (y=744) each reported 'button did NOT fire'. At steps 9 and 10 cash was 303 and 435 against a $300 price, so mult1 was affordable. Cards higher in the list (Dropper 2, Speed 1, Silver, Dropper 3) fired fine. shop_purchases stayed at 4. The lower cards are probably clipped by the panel or scroll frame, or something is blocking the click. This leaves those items unbuyable through the UI.

bugs.title: No visible error feedback (shake/buzz) for unaffordable or refused buys
bugs.evidence: Step 5 (Cash x1.5 at cash 45, unaffordable) and step 8 (Gold at cash 123) produced no shake, buzz or message. The press never fired, so the required error shake and buzz could not be verified. The probe shows no rejection counter for the shop; rebirth_denied=2 comes from the rebirth button.

bugs.title: shop_opened counter is 2 after a single open
bugs.evidence: The playtester pressed ShopUi.ShopButton once, at step 1, and never closed or reopened the panel, yet the probe reports shop_opened=2. The counter may be double-incremented, or the open handler may fire twice.

bug.title: Shop Buy buttons do not fire when pressed
bug.evidence: With the SHOP panel open, I pressed ShopUi.Panel.List.Card_tier_gold.State and Card_mult1.State (Cash x1.5, $300) three times in total. Each result said 'clicked Buy but the button did NOT fire'. The only HUD changes were passive cash and income ticks. Cash was 411 to 591 and later 771, which is enough for the $300 item, and no purchase, green row flash or level bar change followed. No shop_purchases counter appeared in the probe events either. RebirthGui.RebirthButton did fire and showed 'Not ready to rebirth' at $735, which is expected.
